name: ES Opening Auction Pressure Vessel v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: An opening auction with unusually high traded effort per point of realized range represents absorbed pressure rather than equilibrium. Where the final opening price sits relative to the auction's volume-weighted center reveals which side retained the residual imbalance. That imbalance should be released directionally after the opening handoff.

eligibility.opening_pressure: total reported opening volume divided by opening high-low range in ES points
eligibility.reference: median opening pressure of the previous 60 eligible RTH sessions, shifted one session
eligibility.pressure_rule: current opening pressure is strictly greater than the shifted reference median

rules.opening_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price during the opening auction
rules.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.stop_fill: opening auction center plus one adverse ES tick
rules.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
rules.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
rules.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
rules.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: High traded volume per point of opening range behaved like completed two-sided matching rather than stored directional energy. The opening close's location relative to the volume center did not identify a residual imbalance. Both directions lost, so no side or inverse-pressure rescue is permitted.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: testing low pressure after observing high pressure
changing the 60-session lookback or median threshold
volatility, weekday, clock, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
